settings.roundingHint: Applied when showing and invoicing time. Stored entries keep the exact duration.
settings.roundingUpHint: Any started step counts in full: with 15 minutes, 1:01 becomes 1:15.
settings.roundingNearestHint: Time goes to the closer step: with 15 minutes, 1:07 becomes 1:00 and 1:08 becomes 1:15.
settings.fiscalLead: Shown on invoices. Use the VAT, GST or other tax number you are registered under; EU e-invoicing requires it.
settings.adminOnly: Only account admins can change these settings.
settings.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other sessions were signed out.
settings.apiTokensLead: Use these with the API or the browser extension. A token acts as you in this account.
settings.tokenNameHint: Something that reminds you where it is used, e.g. "Browser extension".
settings.readOnlyHint: The token can read data but not change anything.
settings.tokenCreated: Copy your token now. You won't be able to see it again.
settings.revokeConfirm: Revoke "{{name}}"? Anything using it stops working immediately.
settings.auditLead: Every change in this account, who made it and when.
settings.approvalsHint: People submit each week; managers approve it and approved time locks.
settings.remindersHint: On the first morning of the week, people whose last week is incomplete get one email.

data.importLead: Bring an account over from another Honest Robin, cloud or self-hosted: choose its export zip. It becomes a new account here and you become its admin. Everyone else keeps their history and comes over as people to invite again from Team, so nobody joins an account without saying yes.
data.deleteLead: Deletes the account and everything in it after 14 days: time, expenses, invoices, receipts and people. Until then it's read-only, you can still export, and any admin can cancel.
data.deleteDialogBody: In 14 days the account and all its data are deleted for good, its audit log too. Its connections to Stripe, QuickBooks, Xero and Peppol end then, and a subscription is cancelled. Every admin gets an email, and any admin can cancel until then. Backups made before then keep a copy until they are replaced.
data.pending: This account will be deleted on {{date}}. Until then it's read-only, and you can still export its data.
data.bannerPending: This account will be deleted on {{date}} and is read-only until then.
data.bannerReadOnly: This account is read-only. You can still export all its data.
data.bannerLapsed_one: This account is read-only because the Team plan ended. Keep up to {{count}} person who can sign in, or start Team again. You can still export all its data.
data.bannerLapsed_other: This account is read-only because the Team plan ended. Keep up to {{count}} people who can sign in, or start Team again. You can still export all its data.

settings.twoFactorLead: Sign in with your password and a code from an authenticator app on your phone, so a stolen password alone isn't enough. Any app that shows 6-digit codes works.
settings.twoFactorScan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
settings.twoFactorQrAlt: QR code to add Honest Robin to your authenticator app
settings.twoFactorKeyHint: Add an account in the app by hand and type this key (time-based):
settings.twoFactorEnterCode: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows
settings.twoFactorRequiredBy: Required by {{accounts}}, so it stays on.
settings.twoFactorTurnOffLead: Your password (or an emailed link) alone will sign you in again. Your recovery codes stop working.
settings.recoveryCodesLead: Save these recovery codes somewhere safe, away from your phone, such as a password manager. Each signs you in once if you lose your phone. You won't see them again.
settings.recoveryFileHeader: Honest Robin recovery codes. Each code works once.
settings.requireTwoFactorHint: Members who haven't set it up are asked to before they can do anything else. Turn it on for yourself first, under Profile.
settings.twoFactorGateLead: {{account}} requires two-factor sign-in. Set it up to continue: it takes a minute, with any authenticator app on your phone.
settings.dateStyleHint: How dates look on invoices, their PDFs and the page your client sees.

billing.title: Billing
billing.lead: One person is free. A team pays per person who can sign in, and nothing else.
billing.unavailable: Billing isn't set up on this instance yet.
billing.lapsed_one: The Team plan has ended, so this account is read-only. Keep up to {{count}} person who can sign in, or start Team again.
billing.lapsed_other: The Team plan has ended, so this account is read-only. Keep up to {{count}} people who can sign in, or start Team again.
billing.lapsedHow_one: Now {{count}} person can sign in. Deactivating someone keeps everything they tracked, and once you're within the free plan, everything works again at once. Export works all along.
billing.lapsedHow_other: Now {{count}} people can sign in. Deactivating someone keeps everything they tracked, and once you're within the free plan, everything works again at once. Export works all along.
billing.freeBody: For one person, with every feature. To work with your team, start a Team subscription: you pay for each person who can sign in. Invitations are free until they're accepted, and so are people you deactivate.
billing.waiting: Thanks! Your subscription shows here as soon as Paddle confirms it.
billing.pastDue: The last payment didn't go through. Update the payment method to keep the subscription.
billing.invitationsWaiting_one: {{count}} invitation waiting: not billed until accepted
billing.invitationsWaiting_other: {{count}} invitations waiting: not billed until accepted
billing.invitationsLater_one: Starting Team is your yes to the invitation waiting: once it's accepted, you pay for that person too, {{price}}, and that day Paddle charges for what's left of the billing period.
billing.invitationsLater_other: Starting Team is your yes to the {{count}} invitations waiting: as each is accepted, you pay for that person too, {{price}}, and that day Paddle charges for what's left of the billing period.
billing.priceLock: Your price is locked at {{price}} for as long as this subscription runs. Honest Robin refuses any change that would raise it, also when list prices go up.
billing.seatsHint: You pay for the people who can sign in. Someone who accepts an invitation, or comes back, counts from that moment. Someone you deactivate stops counting within 15 minutes.

developers.title: API
developers.lead: Everything the app does goes through this API, so anything you can do in Honest Robin you can do from a script.
developers.tokens: Sign in with a personal access token, sent as a bearer token. Create one under
developers.conventions: Money is an integer in minor units next to its currency; durations are integer seconds; dates are YYYY-MM-DD in the account's time zone. Lists page with a cursor (next_cursor). Errors have a stable code and a message for people. Rates and amounts are left out for people who may not see them.

accounting.title: Accounting
accounting.lead: Invoices and payments go to your accounting system as they happen, so your books keep up without typing anything twice. One way: changes in QuickBooks or Xero don't come back.
accounting.unavailable: {{name}} isn't set up on this instance. Its admin registers an app with {{name}} first.
accounting.notConnected: Not connected. You sign in to {{name}} and choose the company; Honest Robin only adds invoices, payments and customers.
accounting.connected: Connected. Now choose how invoices are booked.
accounting.connectFailed: Connecting didn't finish. Start again here, and finish within half an hour in this same browser.
accounting.itemHint: Every invoice line is booked on it.
accounting.paymentAccountHint: The bank account payments are recorded in.
accounting.taxesHint: Choose the {{name}} tax code for each tax your invoices use. An invoice with a tax that has no code waits until you choose one.
accounting.autoPush: Push invoices and payments as they happen
accounting.autoPushHint: Off: push invoices to {{name}} one by one from the invoice.

device.title: Connect a device
device.lead: Sign in the Honest Robin browser extension, or another app, without typing your password into it.
device.enterCode: The code shown in the extension
device.enterCodeHint: Type it from your extension. Never use a code someone sent you.
device.otherNetwork: This was asked for from a different network than the one you're on now. If you didn't start signing in on this computer just now, decline.
device.invalid: That code is wrong or has expired. Start signing in again from the extension.
device.asks: {{name}} wants to track time as you in {{account}}.
device.checkCode: Only continue if this is the code your extension shows. If you didn't just start signing in, decline.
device.otherAccount: To connect another of your accounts, switch to it in the menu at the bottom left first.
device.approved: {{name}} is connected. You can close this tab and go back to it.
